scenario: [LEXP.8.8.1], [RLOW.6.1.9]: a `const` holds the value the engine computes, so `const R = round(21.5_celsius)` folds to what the same call written inline evaluates to, to the bit: 22 celsius. The `initial` fact carries R's folded value, and rule `inline` compares that slot with the inline call; rule `read` reads R in a rule and compares it with the inline call. Exactly ["inline", "read"]. A folder that rounded the base number gives 295 K, and both miss. PATH PINNED: `dsc.dstest.rlow_6_1_9_folded`'s `float64` arm over `fold_unit_of`, against each runtime's evaluation of the lowering `rlow_6_1_9_in_unit` writes.
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

const R = round(21.5_celsius)

schema V scope explicit:
    k: String
    t: celsius

initial:
    V k: "c" t: R

rule inline:
    V v where v.k == "c" and v.t == round(21.5_celsius)
->
    log info "inline"

rule read:
    V v where v.k == "c" and R == round(21.5_celsius)
->
    log info "read"
